issues: No sign of getting around the measurement. The LightGBM model is trained only on Xtr and the training residuals (y - base_tr). It only predicts on Xte. It does no file or network access and uses no test labels.

No bug that makes the result meaningless. LightGBM gets random_state=seed and n_jobs=8, which is within the harness limits. Averaging stage2 and the LightGBM residual predictions on top of base_te is consistent.

My recomputed z: the candidate (0.3676) is 0.0021 worse than the incumbent (0.3655). The standard error of the difference is 0.0037*sqrt(1/1+1/2) ≈ 0.00453, so z ≈ -0.46. That matches the reported -0.466; the small gap is probably rounding in the means. The reject decision is consistent with the numbers.
Minor point: this adds an extra model and more code for no measured gain, so rejecting it is also in line with 'simpler is better'.
